## Contributor License Agreement (CLA)

After you open this PR, CLA Assistant checks the contributors identified in its commits. If signing is required, the bot posts a comment with a CLA signing link.

- Each contributor who needs to sign must open the bot's link, sign in with their own GitHub account, review the agreement, and complete signing. Opening a PR or checking a box in this template does not sign the CLA.
- If you have already signed but `license/cla` remains pending, check that the email used in your commits is associated with your GitHub account, then use the bot's recheck link. Contact the maintainers if the status still does not update.
- A PR can contain multiple contributor identities; signing as the PR author does not complete signing for everyone else. Do not sign on behalf of another contributor.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the contribution and plugin development guides.
- [ ] I understand that all contributors identified by CLA Assistant must complete any required CLA signing before this contribution can be accepted.
- [ ] Source files, installation instructions, and examples are included or linked.
- [ ] Dependencies, access requirements, and external data transfers are disclosed.
- [ ] No credentials, login caches, or private research data are included.
- [ ] Authorship, licenses, and applicable third-party notices are preserved.
- [ ] Validation results and known limitations are accurately reported.

## Publication Scope

Merging this PR accepts the source contribution; it does not automatically approve official evaluation, marketplace publication, or inclusion as a bundled plugin. Follow the applicable review and release process for publication.
